title: WIC eligibility - federal basics
facts: WIC serves qualifying pregnant, postpartum and breastfeeding women, infants, and children under age 5 who meet program requirements.
Applicants must generally meet categorical, residential, income and nutrition-risk requirements.

WIC uses an income standard set by the state agency within federal limits; certain applicants may be income-eligible automatically through participation in programs such as Medicaid, SNAP or TANF under applicable rules.
WIC is administered by state, territorial and tribal agencies, so application procedures and approved food packages are locally administered within federal rules.
